routes.name: Visa-Free Entry to Greenland
routes.summary: Greenland is part of the Danish realm but not in Schengen. If you can enter Denmark without a visa, you can enter Greenland without one, for up to 90 days. A Schengen visa alone is not valid for Greenland.

other: Visa-exempt for Denmark means visa-exempt for Greenland.
Passport needed. EU or Schengen ID cards do not work, but Nordic ID cards do.

stay.note: Short stays up to 90 days per the visa page. Exact day-count rule not confirmed.

sources.label: Danish Immigration Service: Visa to Greenland

routes.name: Nordic Citizens Free Movement
routes.summary: Citizens of Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden can enter, live and work in Greenland without a permit.

sources.label: Danish Immigration Service: Visa to Greenland

routes.name: Entry on a Danish or Schengen Residence Permit
routes.summary: Since 20 March 2026, third-country nationals with a residence permit from Denmark or another Schengen country can travel to Greenland on that permit. Long-stay D visa holders still need a Greenland visa.

other: C visa holders in Denmark need an entry permit for Greenland.

sources.label: Danish Immigration Service: New access to Greenland
Danish Immigration Service: Visa to Greenland

routes.name: Short-Stay Visa for Greenland
routes.summary: Citizens of visa-required countries need a visa valid for Greenland, applied for at a Danish mission. A Danish or Schengen visa is not valid for Greenland. Fee not stated on the page.

other: Apply with the same form as a Danish visa and include documents for your Greenland stay.
Visa fee not confirmed. Check with the Danish mission.

sources.label: Danish Immigration Service: Visa to Greenland

routes.name: Residence and Work Permit in Greenland
routes.summary: Permit tied to a specific job and employer. Employer usually needs a municipal permit. Pay must match Greenlandic standards and you can't rely on public benefits.

other: Signed contract or job offer, not older than 30 days, with a job description.
Full time, about 40 hours per week.

stay.note: Up to 2 years at a time.

routes.processing: Normally 3 months, up to 6 if more information is needed.

sources.label: Danish Immigration Service: Work in Greenland

routes.name: Fast-Track Greenland
routes.summary: Faster work permit if your employer is approved for Fast-Track by the Government of Greenland.

other: Employer must be on the approved Fast-Track list.
Full time, 40 hours per week, contract not older than 30 days.

routes.processing: About 1 month, up to 3 if more information is needed.

routes.name: Study Residence Permit in Greenland
routes.summary: For students admitted to an approved school in Greenland. Valid up to 1 year at a time.

savings.note: Or DKK 4,200 per month for stays under a year.

eligibility.language: Understand the language of instruction, plus Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, English or German at a reasonable level
other: Folk High School pupils don't need to show self-support.
Under 18: both parents must sign consent.

routes.processing: Normally 3 months, up to 4 if more information is needed.

sources.label: Danish Immigration Service: Study in Greenland

routes.name: Accompanying Family in Greenland
routes.summary: Spouses, cohabiting or registered partners, and children under 18 living at home can be eligible when the main person holds a work permit. Full conditions not confirmed.

other: Full conditions not read from the official page.

sources.label: Danish Immigration Service: Work in Greenland

routes.name: Permanent Residence in Greenland
routes.summary: Permanent permit after 3 years on a spouse or partner permit, or 7 years on work or study grounds. You can't have overdue public debt above DKK 97,436.38 (2026 level).

other: Must still meet the conditions of your current permit.
No overdue public debt above DKK 97,436.38 if over 18.

sources.label: Danish Immigration Service: Permanent residence in Greenland

routes.name: Danish Citizenship (Greenland residents)
routes.summary: Greenland is part of the Danish realm, but Danish naturalization rules and years were not confirmed here. Check the Danish Ministry for Immigration and Integration.

other: Rules not confirmed from an official page.
